text:
The dentist was very calm and patient. I had my wisdom tooth extracted yesterday. It was a wisdom tooth that was horizontally positioned against the bone, and the dentist said it might be a little difficult. But she showed me how easy it was to remove it. It didn't take long, and she was very careful. Today, I'm not in much pain anymore, just a little swelling because the dentist was so gentle. I'm very impressed. Before I transferred to another clinic, my mouth and face were swollen and I was in pain for a week.
I brought my mother here for dental work, and she loved it too.
I also brought my husband for teeth whitening, and he liked it as well.

The dentist here is super professional and super calm. I had the operation on my wisdom tooth (it was totally lying on my gum horizontally) and it was perfect. I had pain for the first few hours after they took my tooth out, but today I can eat everything like normal and I don't feel any pain anymore. If anyone would like to give it a try, this place is worth considering.

text: I had my wisdom tooth extracted 8 months ago. The dentist was an older woman with very weak hands. It took her an hour and a half to pry it out, using a lot of force and force. Since then, my mouth has been numb from my lip to my chin, and I experience extreme sensitivity to touch. Even water from a shower hits my mouth and causes pain. My life has been miserable. I'm so stressed I've cried countless times. I've sought treatment at several well-known hospitals. They only prescribed Vitamin B, but it hasn't improved. Other doctors assessed that the nerve was severely damaged, but whether it's completely severed depends on the time elapsed. If the numbness persists for a year, it means the nerve is severed. I think mine is probably severed. It hasn't improved at all. I chose this clinic because they had the fastest appointment, while other places were fully booked. Later, I understood why they had available slots. When getting dental work done, do your research thoroughly and choose wisely. Making the wrong decision can ruin your life beyond repair.
